# Lines of networking API that privacy-check.py network allows, as `<path>: <token>`.
# A hit is allowed when its file equals <path> and the line contains <token>.
#
# NWPathMonitor only observes whether a network path exists (for the "Reveal when
# offline" rule and the automation rules' network condition); it opens no connection and
# sends nothing.
holzBar/MenuBar/RevealRules/RevealRules.swift: import Network
holzBar/MenuBar/RevealRules/RevealRules.swift: NWPathMonitor
holzBar/MenuBar/Automation/AutomationManager.swift: import Network
holzBar/MenuBar/Automation/AutomationManager.swift: NWPathMonitor
